verdict.rationale: Slate's docs describe agent rules for permissions/behavior ordering (docs-15, docs-20) and orchestration of parallel agents (docs-12, docs-13), but there is no evidence of user-defined rules that trigger actions automatically on external events (e.g., file changes, webhooks, schedule, git events). This is a plausible axis for a coding agent (many support hooks/triggers), so absence of evidence yields none rather than na.
